info.title: Cat Feeder API
info.description: REST API for the owner app and admin dashboard. All times are Thai time (+07:00). Errors always use the Error shape.

deviceAuth.description: Device token shown once when the admin pairs the feeder.

owner_id.description: null until the admin pairs it

synced.description: true when applied_schedule_version equals schedule_version. Show 'Synced ✓' or 'Waiting for feeder…'

mqtt_password.description: Shown once. Put it in secrets.h

device_token.description: Shown once. Put it in secrets.h

ScheduleSaved.description: Saved and published to the feeder. Not proof the feeder has it: check `synced` in the status.

schedule_id.description: Omit to create a new schedule; send an existing one to update it

CommandStatus.description: `sent` = published to the feeder. `done` = a feeding event with this command_id arrived

cat.description: null if the tag is not registered

image_media_id.description: Fetch with GET /media/{media_id}. null if no photo (yet)

RfidResult.description: `tag` = one tag read. A tag only means 'likely visitor' (shared bowl)

file.description: Any phone recording (m4a, aac, mp3, wav), max 2 MB. The server converts it to MP3 for the feeder

raw.description: The exact MQTT payload the feeder sent

get.description: Owner: only their feeders. Admin: every feeder.
Poll every 5 s while the screen is open.

post.description: Returns 202: the command was sent, not done. Poll GET /feeders/{id}/commands/{command_id} until status is `done`. The server never expires a command: a feeder that was offline ignores it once it is over 60 s old (spec rule 9), so it stays `sent`. Give up after about 60 s.
